principle: More intelligence underneath, less interface on top. Progressive disclosure: race state first, evidence on demand.

hierarchy.name: RACE HEADER / STATE
hierarchy.content: event, season, leader lap + progress, race time, track status chip, roster size, weather line
hierarchy.justification: Answers 'where are we' in one strip; already exists as ContextBar + status strip (merge to single strip)

hierarchy.name: TRACK / REPLAY
hierarchy.content: spatial track map (shared T, driver highlight) beside compact running-order tower
hierarchy.justification: Spatial + order is the fastest race-state read; replay owns the only clock

hierarchy.name: SELECTED DRIVER INTELLIGENCE
hierarchy.content: position/gap, one-two primary prediction values, tyre/stint, DETAILS (model/sim/Δ, precision, provenance), EXPLORE STRATEGY, EXPLORE ALTERNATIVE entries
hierarchy.justification: Driver-centric interaction collapses prediction + consensus + uncertainty + strategy + counterfactual entry into one contextual panel

hierarchy.name: RACE CONTROL / EVENT FEED
hierarchy.content: compact chronological feed (flag transitions, SC/VSC, pit stops, retirements, RC messages), click-to-seek, causal-gated at T
hierarchy.justification: Answers 'what changed / what matters' without permanent chart space; doubles as timeline markers source

hierarchy.name: STRATEGY / DECISION CONTEXT
hierarchy.content: NOT a permanent dashboard: availability/status line + EXPLORE STRATEGY entry (target+state prefilled)
hierarchy.justification: Strategy is contextual analysis, not ambient display; keeps V3.6 semantics while removing giant setup from default

hierarchy.name: TIMELINE / REPLAY NAVIGATION
hierarchy.content: play/pause, speed, lap jump, prev/next event, flag/pit/SC markers; moves entire workspace to canonical T
hierarchy.justification: Single state-navigation mechanism; no panel may drift to a different T

arrangement_rationale: Header -> track+order -> driver -> feed -> timeline follows the 30s read order: where are we, where is everyone, what about my driver, what changed, move in time. Strategy/counterfactual/uncertainty/consensus are entries, not panes.
